category: HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) and Water Heating Equipment
unfair_advantage: Proprietary technology and manufacturing expertise in high-efficiency HVAC and water heating equipment
milestone_1: Achieve commercial production of its new high-efficiency HVAC product

milestone_3: Launch a new product line with a significant increase in gross margin

thesis_summary: AAON has a unique position in the HVAC market with its proprietary technology and manufacturing expertise, but faces significant challenges in achieving profitability and scalability.
thesis_breaks_if: AAON fails to achieve commercial production of its new high-efficiency HVAC product within the next 2 years
ten_k_highlights: The Company's revenue has been insufficient to meet the Company's growth expectations.
The Company's gross margin has been declining over the past 5 years.
The Company's share count has increased by 55.5% over the past 5 years, resulting in severe dilution.
valuation_note: FCF yield -1.9%, PEG 3.4, EV/EBITDA 36 — very richly valued — starter position only.
